title: Uniform depth-four AC0 functions with nearly cubic De Morgan formula size
author: Yuval Filmus, Or Meir, and Avishay Tal
work: Shrinkage under Random Projections, and Cubic Formula Lower Bounds for AC0
source_version: Theory of Computing 19 (2023), Article 7, publisher source publication December 5, 2023; DOI 10.4086/toc.2023.v019a007

source_locator.proof_scope: Complete author argument including supplied core constructions

difficulty_reason: The selected obligation constructs a uniform depth-four AC0 family with nearly cubic De Morgan formula size. Its new human core turns hiding projections into fixing projections, proves the dependent two-literal shrinkage bound using filter conditioning, and constructs suitable hiding projections from a soft-adversary distribution. The joined projections yield a source-local composition lower bound, then a surjectivity-based Andreev construction supplies the depth-four upper bound and the nearly cubic lower bound; these are interacting research arguments beyond ordinary formula balancing and KW prerequisites.

source_check.note: Ordinary cited formula balancing, KW correspondence, Beame–Machmouchi surjectivity unweighted-adversary lower bound, and standard counting hard truth tables; full new projection/conversion/filter/composition core preserved. Supporting shrinkage theorems and KRW special case uncounted.
